svg.title: The final window can be smaller than a chunk’s required key union
svg.desc: W = 4; committed prefix N = 5; chunk queries at logical positions 5, 6 and 7
svg.text: The final window can be smaller than a chunk’s required key union
W = 4; committed prefix N = 5; chunk queries at logical positions 5, 6 and 7
Union across queries = positions 2–7: six rows.
Bulk wrap can destroy a still-required key
Appending position 6 into slot 2 overwrites old position 2.
Query 5 is incorrect if it has not finished reading that old position.
Chosen safe schedule: old ring plus private new stage
Keep four old rows 1–4 and stage three new rows 5–7.
Seven allocated rows × 16 scalar KV bytes = 112 payload bytes.
Apply each query’s own local-causal mask, then commit
Expected outputs at 5, 6, 7: 4.5, 5.5, 6.5; final retained range 4–7.
Wait for covered accesses before overwriting; failed stage work must drain.
Six required rows = 96 bytes; chosen allocation = 112 bytes. Neither count includes other workspace.
